captures.description: THE TRACKER, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The ILR Labor Action Tracker is a joint research project by Cornell University's ILR School and the University of Illinois' LER School.' Database scope (against the BLS's 1,000-worker threshold); tools; recent trends. Five cards: the tracker, Cornell ILR (two), Facebook·The Daily Illini, BLS.

atoms.evidence: is a joint research project by Cornell University's ILR School and the University of Illinois' LER School.
provides a comprehensive database and interactive map tracking labor strikes, lockouts, and worker protest activity across the United States.
the Labor Action Tracker captures work stoppages of all sizes (involving six or more workers) as well as non-strike labor protests.
